newsitem.title: TAIWAN: S.Korea strikes spur Taiwan plastics share prices.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea strikes spur Taiwan plastics share prices.

text.p: Plastics shares rose in early Tuesday trade, spurred by rising prices for dioctyl phthalate which were pushed higher by South Korea's nationwide labour strikes, brokers said.

After 45 minutes, Union Petrochemical jumped T$1.10 or 3.5 percent to T$32.60, Dahin rose 90 cents or 3.28 percent to T$28.40. Both are major domestic makers of dioctyl phthalate, a key petrochemical raw material.
"South Korea's labour strikes are benefiting our local industries, especially in plastics and textiles," said National Securities analyst Eric Liu.
